content: I’ve always enjoyed figuring out how technology works and solving technical problems. Over the past few years, I’ve been spending my time learning networking, computer systems, and IT support through self-study and hands-on projects. My main goal is to build a career in network engineering, but I’m also interested in opportunities in IT support, help desk, or system administration where I can continue learning and gain real-world experience. I created this website to share the projects I’ve worked on, document my progress, and show potential employers the skills I’m developing. I’m always looking for ways to learn something new and improve my technical abilities.
title: About Page
